data.plainLyric:
Time to, time to, time to s—
Silence, I was a silence
Searching with sirens
We fleet out the fire
We wild out the towners
That took two downer
We showed you we got show
We are the world (Ooh, ooh)
Ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh-ooh
Ooh-ooh (Time to, time to, time to s—)
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah

I'm with the mafia, you know how it is, you know how it was (Ah)
Shawty ain't playing around
As soon as you mug, she pullin' your plug (Ah)
Speaking of plug, the phone hear rin
You know that I'm pickin' it up (Brr)
Whatever they need, the G6, the oil, or all of the above (Brr-brr)
I stay with some live shit
She pullin' up bitches like one of the bros
(Like that, yeah, like that)
New year on a new yacht out the vault, made a new spot
On wax, not on Tucson, flame a valley like I'm 2Pac (Yeah)
Birds out, whole flu flock, psychos got the new drop
Same middle finger, new opp, get him poked up like a blue shot
Tinted up, they peekin' in, back door like sneakin' in
My Lambo creepin' in, my eater stuck my eater in
Bad bitch obedient, queen like Bohemian
Size up on all these niggas, ain't talkin' medium (Yeah)
If you see the niggas I'm 'round
You know what type of time I'm on (Grr)
Designer shit, we ain't duckin' smoke, we redesign your dome
Out the box, she get out of pocket when it's out the norm
Time is money, I run up the funds and put my AP on
Off the wall, she off that MJ, I'm off the alcohol
One-on-one, this a one-on-one, I used to run it all
Look at God, ain't far from a "B," I'm makin' corporate calls
Look at squad, they act just like me when they teein' off
When they teein' off. When they teein' off
Codeine spritz, I spilled that oil in my Aperol
That's my twin, she look just like me when she teein' off
Ugh, haha

Phonin' home in, sendin' drones in
Time to tear this shit down
We be stationed to our radius
We done waitin', time to burn this shit down
Hold your faith in, just be patient
Right occasion, we gon' burn this shit down
Hit the pavement, we invadin'
We not tradin', time to tear this shit down
One big nation with no patience
Time for ragin', time to burn this shit down

Burn this shit down, burn this shit down
We 'bout to burn this shit out
Burn this shit out, yeah

Grab revolver, throwin' crosses
Kiss my daughter, time to burn this shit down
Please don't call us when it's started
Then go harder, just to burn this shit down

Burn this shit down, burn this shit down
We 'bout to burn this shit out
